scenes.title: Amazing Grace
scenes.subtitle: G, C and D.
lines: In this lesson, you'll learn to play 'Amazing Grace' using the chords G, C and D.
It's part of level 6 of 12, 'First songs'.
We'll play 'Amazing Grace' using just three chords: G, C and D.
The song has a gentle rhythm of three beats per bar at 80 beats per minute.
You're all set to play 'Amazing Grace' with the chords we've learned.
Take a breath, strum with confidence, and let the app listen through the microphone as you play.
